title: Gamepad Tester Pro
shortDescription: Check if your controller works: buttons, joystick, stick drift, triggers, rumble

sections.title: Gamepad & Controller Tester for Android
paragraphs: Is your controller working? Pair or plug in any Xbox, PlayStation (DualShock 4, DualSense), Switch Pro or generic gamepad over Bluetooth, USB or OTG and see every button, stick and trigger respond on screen in seconds. Gamepad Tester Pro then checks stick drift, dead zone, vibration, input lag and polling rate, scores the controller's health and gives you a report you can share.

sections.title: Popular ways people use this app
bullets: Check stick drift and dead zone before buying or selling a used controller
Confirm a new gamepad works before the return or warranty window closes
Diagnose missed inputs, double presses, sticky buttons or a dead trigger
Compare Bluetooth vs USB polling rate and input lag before a ranked match
Controller not working or not detected? See whether Android receives any input before you blame the game
Use it as a live gamepad viewer with key codes when setting up an emulator or remote play

sections.title: Full Controller Test & Health Score
bullets: One guided test for buttons, D-pad, analog sticks, L2/R2 triggers, stick drift and vibration
Health score with per-item results, saved to Test History automatically
Export a visual test report for support, repairs or resale listings

sections.title: Button Test & Joystick Test in Real Time
bullets: See every press, release and Android key code instantly, with key history
Both analog sticks, axes, D-pad and analog trigger pressure, live
Layouts for Xbox, PlayStation, generic gamepads and TV remotes

sections.title: Stick Drift Test, Dead Zone & Circularity
bullets: Live stick position, resting offset and a dead-zone guide
Advanced analysis: coverage, circularity error, radius range, dead-zone estimate

sections.title: Input Lag, Latency & Polling Rate Test
bullets: Polling rate in Hz with average, minimum and maximum input interval
Advanced sampling: jitter, interval histogram, Bluetooth vs USB comparison, CSV export

sections.title: Vibration Test & Rumble Studio
bullets: Test left and right rumble motor strength independently
Vibration Studio: build multi-segment dual-motor patterns, loop and save them

sections.title: LED Light Test (PlayStation over Bluetooth)
bullets: Set the light bar color, then run solid-color, hue sweep and breathing checks
Spot dead spots, color tint, jumps or flicker
Needs DualShock 4 or DualSense over Bluetooth on Android 12+. Wired PS, Xbox and other pads do not expose their light to Android, and the app tells you why.

sections.title: Gyroscope, Touchpad & Dual Controller Compare
bullets: Gyroscope, accelerometer and tilt level for DualShock 4, DualSense and Switch Pro (Android 12+)
Touchpad test with multi-touch trails

sections.title: Controller Info & Health Trends
paragraphs: See brand, device name, Vendor ID, Product ID, connection type, axes, button count, vibration support and battery level when exposed. Test History tracks health score and drift trends per controller, so you catch a failing stick early.

sections.title: Please note
bullets: Features depend on the controller model, connection type, Android version and phone maker. Some controllers do not report battery, vibration, motion sensors or a touchpad.
The app reads input only. It cannot remap buttons, update firmware or repair hardware.
Core tests are free with ads. Pro is a one-time purchase that removes ads and unlocks advanced diagnostics, health trends, CSV export and saved vibration patterns.

sections.title: Something not working?
paragraphs: If your controller is not detected or a result looks wrong, email feedback@dapplebyte.com before leaving a review. Tell us your controller and phone model and we will help.
